title: Frederick Valentich Flight 1978
hook: Who vanished over Bass Strait in 1978?
headline: Mystery over Bass Strait

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: On 21 November, 20-year-old pilot Frederick Valentich took off from Moorabbin Airport.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: He reported a green light at about 1,400 m (4,500 ft) altitude.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Radio logs show his final transmission at 2:14 am, asking, "Is there anyone there?"

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Searches found only a crashed buoy and a missing-person report, no wreckage.

end.line: What do you think caused the strange lights?

description: The 1978 disappearance of pilot Frederick Valentich over Bass Strait remains baffling.

facts.claim: Frederick Valentich, a 20-year-old pilot, departed Moorabbin Airport on 21 November 1978.
He reported a bright green light hovering near his Cessna at about 3 km altitude.
His final radio transmission was recorded at 2:14 am, asking "Is there anyone there?".
Searches recovered only a buoy and found no aircraft wreckage.
The case remains classified as an unsolved aviation mystery.
